description: This file defines configuration options and validators for Redis-based grain directory in Orleans.

classes.name: RedisGrainDirectoryOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for the Redis-based Orleans grain directory, including Redis client configuration, connection multiplexer creation delegate, and entry expiry settings.

classes.name: RedactRedisConfigurationOptions
classes.description: Custom attribute class for redacting Redis configuration options, preventing sensitive data like passwords from being exposed.

classes.name: RedisGrainDirectoryOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validator class that checks the validity of RedisGrainDirectoryOptions, primarily ensuring that configuration options are provided.

methods.name: DefaultCreateMultiplexer
methods.description: Default static method to create and connect a Redis connection multiplexer asynchronously based on provided options.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Method that performs validation on the RedisGrainDirectoryOptions instance, throwing an exception if configuration is invalid.
